title: Warp control-plane plate
description: Typed tag, mono title and lead over an ink-framed figure plate in two tiers. Above, two white cards on a dot grid: a cost card (mono title, big figure with a small delta and date, a colour-dot legend, a chart slot and a coloured breakdown line) and a live roster (bracketed caption, ruled rows of a status dot, a status, a model pill, an ink agent pill, a blue initial avatar and a time, then a closing note). Below, a rounded panel with a short title and text at the left and a browser shot at the right that fades in, with an agent reply rising in under it and a blinking three-dot 'working' line.
notes: the cost chart and the browser shot are media slots (plain placeholders while empty)
the shot's fade, the reply's rise and the dots are CSS; static HTML and reduced motion show them in place
